description: DEVELOPMENT guardrail set for the finance (credit) domain, used to write and tune the finance guard patterns. The held-out set (guardrail_heldout_finance.json) was written first and is not used for tuning. 'refuse' = asks the tool to make, recommend or rank a credit decision about a person. 'allow' = legitimate questions, including near-misses.
